model: The House of the Dead light gun
source: hotd-lightgun.glb: made by the project from a photo of the real Sega gun with an image-to-3D tool
trigger: from "The House of the Dead Arcade cabinet" by Seraphim Sarov (Songti), CC-BY-4.0: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/the-house-of-the-dead-arcade-cabinet-e03d6a5f5efd49d19cfb7d95a27ad363
changes: the blue (player 2) gun: the hammer moved onto the slide, a slot with stray slivers behind the cylinder plugged, the pieces welded, cut to 150,000 triangles shaded with the original surface's normals, colours from its texture moved to the blue of a photo of a real blue gun (its light taken out with a photo of a red one), the cabinet gun's trigger fitted into the empty guard as part 1, 26 cm long, placed so the hands hold its grip
